reason: The core idea of using Y and Hf microalloying to improve thermal stability and corrosion resistance in AlCoCrFeNi2.1 is directly taken from P2, which already demonstrated these effects in a laser-clad coating of the same alloy. The hypothesis merely proposes applying the same intervention to a bulk form and adds a creep test, which is a minor extension of the existing result rather than a new synthesis or transfer.
